import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();after=json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text());assert after['count']==13 and not after['mismatches']
exclude={'MANIFEST.json','terminal_manifest_29.receipt.json','terminal_manifest_29.output.txt'}
files=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not f.is_file():continue
 name=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if name in exclude:continue
 assert not f.is_symlink();b=f.read_bytes();files.append({'path':name,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
completed=[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')]
manifest={'kind':'actual own-lane byte manifest','files':files,'completed_receipt_JSONs_included':completed,'terminal_noncircular_exclusions':{'MANIFEST.json':'Self hash cannot be included noncircularly.','terminal_manifest_29.receipt.json':'Runner creates this receipt after this manifest code finishes; this is the only still-completing receipt excluded.','terminal_manifest_29.output.txt':'Runner creates this stdout artifact after this manifest code finishes.'},'frozen_after':'frozen-after.json included; all13 checked with no mismatches; no frozen input changed afterward.','credit':0,'limits':'Byte/documentary integrity is not mathematical acceptance. Procedure qualification retained in PROCEDURE.md.'}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'files_manifested':len(files),'completed_receipts_included':len(completed),'frozen_after_count':13,'mismatches':[],'terminal_exclusions':sorted(exclude),'qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0}))
